The '''YC-123B transport hauler''' was a model of [[transport]] manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. A [[troop transport]], the YC-123B transport hauler could deploy up to 120 passengers onto the battlefield via a large carrying compartment under the cockpit. It was armed with two CEC [[FP-35 forward heavy laser cannon]]s, one on each side of the ship, as well as a CEC [[AG-3M triple laser cannon turret]] aft of the cockpit. The [[Resistance]] owned one such [[Starship|ship]], the [[Fortitude (transport)|''Fortitude'']],<ref name="TROS VD" /> which was used during the [[battle of Exegol]] and helped in the destruction of the [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']].<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>
